newsitem.title: CANADA: Koch Oil raises Canada posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Koch Oil raises Canada posted oil prices.

text.p: Koch Oil Co Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$5.00/cubic metre or C$0.79/barrel, to C$191.00/cubic metre or C$30.37/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows:
Cromer light sour C$188.00/cubic metre, or C$29.89/barrel
Bow River at Hardisty C$167.00/cubic metre, or C$26.55/barrel
Hardisty medium C$174.00/cubic metre, or C$27.66/barrel
Midale at Cromer C$175.00/cubic metre, or C$27.82/barrel
